A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their complete main texts, figures, tables, equations, and appendices support comparison despite substantial reformatting and selective additions and removals.

before.justification: V2 reports original path-finding accuracies, learned embedding geometries, training dynamics, and ablation results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V3 retains original empirical results and adds experiments on initialization, regularization, self-edges, and geometric-memory diagnostics.

M1.justification: The underlying edge-memorization/path-finding procedures and tied, cross-entropy Node2Vec formulation remain. The additions concern diagnostic measures and experimental variants; they do not establish a new proposed training or inference method.

E1.justification: V3 adds self-loop-augmented cycle-graph memorization, introducing identity associations into the training scenario (Appendix C.3.1, Figure 25). The principal path-star, tree-star, and four tiny-graph families remain.

E2.justification: The weight-untying comparisons are narrowed: v2 reports both untied Node2Vec and Transformer results in Section 4.4 and Appendix D.4, whereas v3 retains a Transformer cycle example without corresponding untied Node2Vec results. The main architecture comparisons and associative-memory controls remain.

E3.justification: V3 introduces a fixed 10,000-step sensitivity study and geometric-margin and normalized eigenspectrum evaluation procedures (Appendices B.5 and C.3.1). It also changes reported TinyGPT settings from eight heads to one and cycle/irregular embedding widths from 16 to 32. These are reported protocol changes; rerunning retained experiments is not established.

E4.justification: New analyses test when initialization, learning rate, weight decay, dropout, and self-edges favor geometric storage (Figures 25–31), supplemented by spectral projections in Figure 7. V2's large-path-star UMAP and pathwise-distance analyses, hardest-token-only geometry heatmaps, and several weight-untying diagnostics are removed. The pause-token, reverse-edge, and interleaving studies remain.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seed-based variability, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The new experiments do not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Headline path-star and tree-star accuracies are retained. V3 adds setting-specific geometric margins, including 7.87 without regularization, -0.75 with unit-normal initialization at low learning rate, and 11.99 at higher learning rate (Figures 26, 28, 29). It removes v2's pathwise edge-only result showing no clustering diagonal (Figure 26). These are additions and removals, not across-version performance gains.

T1.justification: Section 2.5 extends geometric memory to full-rank and signed factorizations whose global information is accessible through probes. Appendix B.5 defines the geometric-margin diagnostic mathematically. The representational-complexity propositions and Node2Vec derivations in Appendices E–F are largely retained, with clarification and renumbering.

C1.justification: The abstract, four stated contributions, and conclusion retain the same central claims: implicit in-weights reasoning, geometric memory, the memorization puzzle, and spectral bias without typical explicit pressures. Additional evidence and grokking connections do not replace these headline contributions.

C2.justification: V3 expands the negative-eigendirection explanation into a mechanism for suppressing self-logits and explains why self-edges reduce zigzagging (Section 4.4). It adds diagnostic false-positive/false-negative qualifications, initialization-dependent boundaries, and a grokking interpretation (Appendices B.5 and C.3.1). The standalone limitations section remains substantively unchanged.

D1.justification: V3 adds a reproduction-code link, initialization distributions, graph-specific tiny-model training recipes, and explicit Node2Vec learning-rate, batch-size, width, and training-duration details. One disclosure is inconsistent: Appendix C.3.1 gives initialization scale 0.2, while Appendix B.2.2 and the figure captions give 0.02.

R1.justification: V3 adds targeted connections to grokking, rank-minimizing regularization, representation shattering in knowledge editing, and identity statements, together with the original node2vec citation. The extensive existing research-positioning framework remains; bibliographic updates to retained works do not constitute new citations.

P1.justification: Section 2 is substantially rewritten to foreground the in-weights task and hardest-token result. Contextual background is shifted toward Appendix A, Section 4 is reorganized around clearer questions, and Appendices B–D are restructured. These narrative changes extend beyond simply inserting new experiments.

P2.justification: The main text and references switch to a two-column format with running headers. Figures are extensively split, condensed, moved, replaced, and supplemented: v3 uses compact main-text summaries, retains detailed accuracy panels in Appendix A, and introduces multi-panel spectral and sensitivity displays. Table 1 is expanded and reflowed.

improvement.justification: The new regularization controls and quantitative geometry diagnostics strengthen the central empirical argument, while fuller recipes and a code link improve reproducibility. These gains outweigh the loss of some earlier diagnostics, but the removed negative pathwise-clustering result, inconsistent initialization values, and dropout comparison that also changes learning rate limit the overall improvement.
